Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a peptide-pull down (affinity purification) approach combined with SILAC for quantification. While the study investigates acyl-modifications, the proteomics assay itself is used to identify the *readers* (proteins that bind to the modified peptides), not to map the acyl-modifications on the proteome. Therefore, it is routed as an AP-MS workflow rather than a PTM-enrichment workflow.

scope: The peptide-bound beads (40 uL slurry) were incubated with 1 mg Hela nuclear extracts.

The bound proteins were eluted with 2x SDS sample buffer (100 mM Tris-HCl pH6.8, 4% SDS, 12% glycerol, 2% β-mercaptoethanol, 0.008% bromophenol), separated with the bait peptides on SDS-PAGE, and subjected to trypsin digestion and LC-MS/MS analysis.
